name: whispertype
description: WhisperType, push-to-talk voice dictation for Windows and macOS: Whisper runs on the local GPU and the text lands in the app in focus; the Python package under whispertype/ (the app, audio capture, the transcription engine process with its spool and jobs, the per-OS backends, the Tk and AppKit UI with its overlay), main.py, the installers (install.bat, install_mac.sh).

glossary.engine: whispertype/transcribe.py, engine_proc.py, jobs.py, spool.py (the transcription engine and its queue)
glossary.app: the rest of whispertype/ and main.py
